title: Comparison Matrix Proposal v1 (comparison-matrix-proposal-v1)
description: Structural contract for the Comparison Planner agent output that `comparison plan` persists and `comparison matrix` merges as the reviewed default. What is checked: the envelope names a contract, and every entry carries the four fields the prompt declares with no `?` — methodId, classification, rationale, sources — because a proposal that reaches the researcher has to be a decision per method, not prose. What is deliberately NOT checked here: that methodId is one of the candidates in the context, that each sources id exists in the provided literature (no invented citations), that rationale is non-blank and that relevanceNote is a string when present — all of those need the request context and stay in validateMatrixProposal (src/comparison/planner.ts:264). No length or count ceilings: a longer rationale or an extra citation is not a defect, and an empty entries array is refused by the validator rather than by minItems.

relevanceNote.description: Written `str?` in the prompt, so it stays optional; the matrix stores it as plannerNote.

notes.description: Top-level notes; the prompt writes `[str?]`, so the element type stays unchecked.
